meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 简化药物发现中的分子数据处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做药物发现或化学信息学，需要处理分子结构数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular data processing in drug discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery or cheminformatics and need to process molecular structures.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以用 datamol 库处理化学分子：读取 SMILES、标准化结构、计算描述符和指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象、可视化等。所有操作返回 RDKit 分子对象。
howto.when: 当你要求处理化学分子数据（如 SMILES、SDF 文件），或进行药物发现相关分析（如相似性搜索、骨架分析）时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 SDF 文件并计算所有分子的 LogP。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并计算描述符。

say.text: 对这组 SMILES 进行 Butina 聚类，阈值 0.3。
say.note: Claude 会按结构相似性分组。

say.text: 生成这个分子的 3D 构象并计算 SASA。
say.note: Claude 会生成 3D 结构并计算溶剂可及表面积。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process chemical molecules using the datamol library: read SMILES, standardize structures, compute descriptors and fingerprints, cluster, generate 3D conformers, visualize, etc. All operations return RDKit Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to handle chemical molecular data (e.g., SMILES, SDF files) or perform drug discovery analyses (e.g., similarity search, scaffold analysis).

say_en.text: Read this SDF file and compute LogP for all molecules.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and compute descriptors.

say_en.text: Butina cluster these SMILES with cutoff 0.3.
say_en.note: Claude will group by structural similarity.

say_en.text: Generate 3D conformers for this molecule and compute SASA.
say_en.note: Claude will generate 3D structure and compute solvent accessible surface area.
